title: Exclusive-Meta to put AI chip into production in September as it looks to double computing capacity, memo shows
title_zh: 备忘录显示，Exclusive-Meta 将于 9 月将人工智能芯片投入生产，希望将计算能力提高一倍
summary: Meta Platforms plans to start manufacturing an artificial intelligence chip from September as part of its plan to boost overall ‌computing power to 14 gigawatts next year, showed an internal memo reviewed by Reuters.
summary_zh: 路透社查阅的一份内部备忘录显示，Meta Platforms 计划从 9 月开始制造人工智能芯片，作为明年将整体计算能力提高到 14 吉瓦计划的一部分。

title: How Jeff Bezos fueled Lyft's comeback: CEO
title_zh: 杰夫·贝佐斯如何推动 Lyft 东山再起：首席执行官
summary: Lyft CEO David Risher explains to Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi how Jeff Bezos's customer obsession became his operating playbook to launch a hard reset at Lyft.
summary_zh: Lyft 首席执行官 David Risher 向雅虎财经执行编辑 Brian Sozzi 解释了 Jeff Bezos 对客户的痴迷如何成为他在 Lyft 实施硬重置的运营手册。

title: Nigerian Stocks Vault Past Korea’s Kospi to Claim World’s Top Returns
title_zh: 尼日利亚股市超越韩国 Kospi 成为全球回报率最高的股票
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Nigerian equities have overtaken South Korea’s to hand investors the highest dollar-based returns this year, as souring sentiment on artificial-intelligence stocks pushes the Asian nation’s world-beating rally into bear territory.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——尼日利亚股市已经超越韩国股市，为投资者带来了今年最高的以美元为基础的回报，因为人工智能股票的情绪恶化将这个亚洲国家的世界领先的涨势推入了熊市。

title: India removes import duty on some electronics, smartphone parts
title_zh: 印度取消部分电子产品、智能手机零部件的进口关税
summary: India has scrapped import duties ‌on some parts used to make ‌mobile phones and other electronic devices, removing the ​current 7.5% and 5% levies, in a move that could help companies like Apple and Xiaomi.
summary_zh: 印度取消了一些用于制造手机和其他电子设备的零部件的进口关税，取消了目前的 7.5% 和 5% 的关税，此举可能有助于苹果和小米等公司。

title: The uncertainty investors should anticipate from midterm elections
title_zh: 投资者应预期中期选举的不确定性
summary: The US midterm elections are just a few months away, so what do they represent for US markets (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) in the meantime? Yahoo Finance Senior Business Reporter Ines Ferré outlines the uncertainty that midterm election years bring to markets.
summary_zh: 距离美国中期选举只有几个月的时间了，那么在此期间它们对美国市场（^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC）代表什么？雅虎财经高级商业记者 Ines Ferré 概述了中期选举年给市场带来的不确定性。

title: China warned that Anthropic's Claude Code puts your data at risk. Is that true?
title_zh: 中国警告称，Anthropic 的克劳德代码会使您的数据面临风险。这是真的吗？
summary: Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley discusses China's warning that Anthropic's (ANTH.PVT) Claude Code could expose sensitive user data.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经科技编辑丹·豪利 (Dan Howley) 讨论了中国关于 Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) 克劳德代码可能泄露敏感用户数据的警告。

title: Meta is expanding its data center build-out to Canada
title_zh: Meta 正在将其数据中心建设扩展到加拿大
summary: Meta says it will build its first data center in Canada.
summary_zh: Meta 表示将在加拿大建立第一个数据中心。
